results.title: ITME: Inference Tiered Memory Expansion with Disaggregated CXL-Hybrid Memories
results.content: ITME implements differentiated fallback policies for cache misses. While a model weight miss inevitably triggers a pipeline stall, a KV cache miss is resolved through dynamic recomputation on the GPU. This design choice avoids the inefficiency of retrieving isolated missing blocks from the remote tier, which would necessitate either suboptimal chunk-sized transfers or complex retrieval logic. Consequently, recomputing the missing KV segments directly on the GPU is more performance-efficient [...] than replacing these stacks, ITME serves as a high-performance memory backend that integrates seamlessly with established tiering mechanisms. Furthermore, its internal hardware-level prefetching complements various scheduling policies, effectively hiding access latency by overlapping data movement with ongoing computation. This synergy allows ITME to maximize KV cache reuse and system efficiency within any established inference hierarchy. [...] mitigates memory capacity and I/O bottlenecks through software prefetching and read-priority scheduling. Overall, ITME enhances conventional CPU-offloading by providing the necessary memory expansion to accommodate large KV cache footprints beyond host memory limits, achieving up to a 35.7% throughput improvement.

results.title: SK hynix AI Infrastructure Analysis Says Architecture Now Sets the Performance Ceiling
results.content:
The key-value cache, or KV cache, stores attention data from previous tokens so the model does not recompute the entire context. It saves computation but occupies memory, and its size grows with longer contexts and more concurrent sessions.

This creates a different capacity problem from model training. A training cluster can often process large, planned batches. An inference service must handle unpredictable requests, varying context lengths, and user-facing latency targets. [...] Model evolution creates another uncertainty. Techniques that reduce KV cache size can weaken memory pressure. Quantization, which represents values with fewer bits, can reduce model and cache footprints. Improved attention methods can change access patterns. [...] The KV cache avoids repeating earlier attention calculations, but the tradeoff moves pressure into memory. Capacity determines how many sessions can remain active. Bandwidth determines how quickly the system can retrieve their state.

High Bandwidth Memory, or HBM, addresses part of this problem. HBM vertically stacks memory dies and places high-bandwidth memory close to an accelerator. This arrangement supplies data much faster than conventional memory located farther from the processor.

results.content: Data that requires substantial memory capacity, such as the KV cache, and memory-intensive operations, such as the attention layer\, are representative use cases for this type of architecture. With high-speed, flexible interconnects and flexible, compute-capable memory configurations, these workloads can be assigned to separate memory resources or near-memory acceleration domains. This reduces the burden on GPUs/NPUs/TPUs to retrieve and process all data directly, while allowing devices to [...] The compute-memory disparity becomes even more pronounced with large language models(LLMs). Each time an LLM generates a token, it refers to the previous context and handles vast amounts of intermediate data through the KV cache\ and attention operations. As models reason for longer periods and maintain longer contexts, their requirements for memory capacity and bandwidth\ drastically increase. The memory bottleneck becomes larger and larger as these memory demands increase. results.title: Samsung และ SK Hynix ทรุดตัวลงอย่างหนัก หลัง Google ‘TurboQuant’ สร้างความปั่นป่วนในกลุ่มเซมิคอนดักเตอร์: หรือจะเป็นเพียง ‘สัญญาณหลอก’?
results.content: ในมุมมองทางเทคนิค เทคโนโลยีนี้สามารถใช้ได้กับการใช้ VRAM แบบไดนามิกระหว่างกระบวนการประมวลผล (Inference) เท่านั้น (โดยหลักคือ KV Cache) และไม่เกี่ยวข้องกับน้ำหนักของโมเดล (Model Weights) แต่อย่างใด กล่าวอีกนัยหนึ่งคือ ความสำเร็จที่ยิ่งใหญ่ที่สุดของเทคโนโลยีนี้คือการปรับปรุงประสิทธิภาพการดำเนินงาน แต่ไม่สามารถลดพื้นที่จัดเก็บข้อมูลที่โมเดลขนาดใหญ่ต้องการได้ [...] การเปิดตัวเทคโนโลยีนี้มีแนวโน้มสูงที่จะช่วยลดความร้อนแรงของตลาดเซมิคอนดักเตอร์ในปัจจุบัน และช่วยลดฟองสบู่การประเมินมูลค่าของหุ้นกลุ่มหน่วยความจำ ซึ่งพิสูจน์ให้เห็นว่าความต้องการหน่วยความจำอาจไม่ได้ไร้ขีดจำกัดเสมอไป ทั้งนี้ ด้วยการเปิดตัวเทคโนโลยีที่คล้ายคลึงกันและความก้าวหน้าของอัลกอริทึม การเติบโตของความต้องการพื้นที่จัดเก็บข้อมูลอาจเผชิญกับภาวะคอขวดได้ [...] นอกจากนี้ เมื่อพิจารณาว่าจำนวนพารามิเตอร์ในโมเดล AI กำลังเติบโตแบบทวีคูณ อัลกอริทึมดังกล่าวสามารถช่วยประหยัดพื้นที่จัดเก็บข้อมูลผ่านการบีบอัดได้สูงสุดเพียง 6 เท่าในปัจจุบัน ซึ่งอาจเป็นเพียงการแก้ปัญหาเพียงเล็กน้อยเมื่อเทียบกับขนาดความต้องการทั้งหมด

results.title: Scaling AI inference with multi‑tier storage | Seagate ASEAN
results.content:
The real shift is that the KV cache is no longer confined to memory. Instead, it can now be managed across a tiered set of storage resources that can scale capacity, allowing inference systems to retain more prior work and reduce recomputation at its source. [...] ### Treating context as persistent state

This is where I see the approach beginning to change. Instead of treating KV cache as a memory-bound optimisation, it can be viewed as a persistent state that’s retained, retrieved and reused across inference cycles. [...] I believe our work with SK hynix reflects a broader architectural shift already underway. As inference engines become more stateful, the boundary between memory and storage begins to blur.

results.title: LAM: What is the KV Cache Hiding? - by Claus Aasholm
results.content:
The LAM result from a revenue perspective was as expected, a couple of per cent above the Q1-26 guidance. However, profitability is increasing at a faster rate, supporting LAM’s operating-leverage narrative.

The manufacturing expansion from prior years is now operational and generates higher volumes without similar cost growth, tool-maturity impacts, warranty costs, or installation costs. [...] The Chinese memory makers were not part of the same oversupply cycle that crushed Samsung and SK Hynix. They were still in build-out and ramp mode throughout 2022-2023, constructing greenfield capacity from scratch. So their equipment spending continued even as Korean and US memory makers slammed the brakes. [...] The geographic perspective shows that the cyclical collapse affected Korea more than China, whose revenue share shot up to 50%.

This is somehow counterintuitive as China also relies on memory tools from LAM, but the Chinese memory companies were in a different state.
